full.limitation: Code-level leakage boundaries require tests; this audit validates saved provenance and outputs, not historical independence.

character_diagnostic.definition: Levenshtein distance over casefold space-joined predicted observations versus care-GT sorted by bbox-center-y then x; includes order, spaces, missing and extra text; not pure recognizer CER.

checkpoint_loading_qualification.scope: Checkpoint compatibility and exact tensor replay, not an additional recognition result

final_audit.limitation: Byte and count qualification does not establish historical independence or model efficacy.

bert_receipt.label: Image-wide BERT counterfactual evidence
bert_receipt.model_set: Frozen BERT target PLL, all original OCR windows

limitations: Historically explored cohorts; source calibration exposure and two known TRAIN/TEST RGB duplicates.
One generator/selector seed; conditional image bootstrap omits training variation and historical selection.
New method is an unvalidated adaptation, not faithful tokenization-paper reproduction or an established novel method.
Presence supervision is care-annotation coverage, not physical text-presence ground truth.
Clean alignment and synthetic empirical noise are assumptions, not manually audited perfect labels.
Window pooling includes all other OCR tokens but does not jointly encode an arbitrarily long image transcript.
Current RGB and recognizer weights unchanged; no new crops or OCR; RTX3090 does not qualify 8GiB.
Predeclared supplementary composition on historically explored cohorts, not independent validation.
Larger CAL policy search can overfit the100-image calibration cohort.
Correct-first protects selected edits; it does not certify their correctness.
metric: micro per-image casefold whitespace-token multiset; punctuation and empty observations retained; all care GT; no IoU or ignored-prediction neutralization

boundary.caveat: GT-assisted maximum correct count, not deployable policy or F1 optimum; perfect-precision bound assumes free FP deletion.
